description_en: Queries the details of a Supabase branch
description_zh: 查询 Supabase 分支详情
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-branch --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --branch-id br-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBranch

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a child branch, the region of the primary branch is inherited by default
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。创建主分支时必须指定，创建子分支时默认继承主分支所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The branch ID, which uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
parameters.help_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支
parameters.name: branch_id

Branch.description_en: The branch information. Each element represents a Supabase branch
Branch.description_zh: 分支列表。每个元素表示一个 Supabase 分支

BranchId.description_en: The branch ID, which uniquely identifies a Supabase branch
BranchId.description_zh: 分支 ID，用于唯一标识一个 Supabase 分支

ComputeEndpoint.description_en: The connection information of the compute node associated with the branch
ComputeEndpoint.description_zh: 分支关联的计算节点连接信息

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the branch was created, in ISO 8601 UTC format
CreateTime.description_zh: 分支创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间

ExpiresAt.description_en: The time when the branch expires and is automatically deleted, in ISO 8601 UTC format
ExpiresAt.description_zh: 分支过期自动删除时间，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间

InitSource.description_en:
The initialization source of the branch.

Valid values:
ParentData: Copies the schema and data from the parent branch. This is the default value.
SchemaOnly: Copies only the schema structure
InitSource.description_zh:
分支初始化来源。

取值：
ParentData：复制父分支的 Schema 和数据，默认值。
SchemaOnly：仅复制 Schema 结构

IsDefault.description_en: Indicates whether this is the default branch

ParentBranchId.description_en: The parent branch ID, which specifies the parent branch of a new branch or a query condition
ParentBranchId.description_zh: 父分支 ID，用于指定新分支或查询条件的上级分支

ParentBranchName.description_en: The parent branch name. This value is empty or displayed as - for the primary branch
ParentBranchName.description_zh: 父分支名称。主分支为空或显示为 -

ParentLSN.description_en: The LSN of the parent branch at the time this branch was created
ParentLSN.description_zh: 该分支创建时对应父分支的 LSN

ParentTimestamp.description_en:
The data synchronization point in time selected from the parent branch when this branch was created, in ISO 8601 UTC format.

Description:
For child branches, this value indicates the point in time of the parent branch selected during creation.
If no parent branch exists, the value 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z is returned
ParentTimestamp.description_zh:
该分支从父分支创建时选择的数据同步时间点，格式为 ISO 8601 UTC 时间。

说明：
子分支返回创建时选择的父分支时间点。
无父分支时返回 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z

ProjectId.description_en: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the primary branch
ProjectId.description_zh: 主分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID

Protected.description_en: Indicates whether branch protection is enabled. A value of true indicates that branch protection is enabled. A value of false indicates that branch protection is disabled
Protected.description_zh: 是否开启分支保护。取值 true 表示开启，false 表示关闭

ServiceType.description_en:
The service type.

Valid values:
Supabase: Supabase service.
Memory: Memory service
ServiceType.description_zh:
服务类型。

可选值：
Supabase：Supabase 服务。
Memory：Memory 服务

SpbProjectId.description_en: The Supabase project ID that corresponds to the current branch
SpbProjectId.description_zh: 当前分支对应的 Supabase 项目 ID
